text:
Predicates:
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
Loaned(x, y) ::: x is loaned out to y.
Brazillian(x) ::: x is a Brazillian footballer.
Plays(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
FootballClub(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
FootballPlayer(ailton) ∧ Loaned(ailton, braga) ::: Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
Brazillian(ailtonSilva) ∧ Plays(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazillian footballer who plays for Nautico.
FootballClub(nautico) ∧ FootballClub(braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
FootballClub(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
∃x (FootballClub(x) ∧ Loaned(ailtonSilva, x)) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to a football club.
